The source_error judgment records authored errors in intermediate prose or labels: q-108567 says 'After $t=3,$' although the third segment starts at t=6; q-70903 says the tangent is evaluated at x=1 although its calculation correctly evaluates x=3; q-124475 incorrectly labels the tangent ratio as tan(A), when it is tan(B); q-72768 labels the computed triangle area A_ACD while discussing triangle ACB. None changes the final answer. q-72764 rounds an intermediate area prematurely, but using the unrounded value still gives 19 square centimeters.\n\nFor q-59711 and q-108462, using the source's explicit positive-acceleration convention, increasing speed occurs from 0 to 30 seconds and from 30 to 60 seconds, respectively. The decreasing segments represent deceleration, which is also nonzero signed acceleration in physics terminology. For q-59760, v=5t until t=4 gives v=20, followed by constant speed through t=10. For q-108567, the successive graph vertices are (0,0), (3,3), (6,3), and (9,4.5). For q-70903, differentiating the base-10 logarithm gives y'=3/(x ln(10))+3x², hence 27+1/ln(10) at x=3.\n\nFor q-28266, (2x+4)/(x-1)=5 gives x=3 and area (2)(10)/2=10. For q-76773, sqrt(3)x/(x+4)=tan(30°) gives x=2 and area 6sqrt(3). For q-124475, 2sqrt(3)x/(x+2)=tan(60°) gives x=2 and area 8sqrt(3).\n\nFor q-18688, substitution gives a=1.2 and b=1.4. For q-112561, elimination gives x=-2 and y=3, hence x+y=1. For q-26223, the scaled equations 3x-y=6 and 6x+8y=2 give x=5/3 and y=-1. For q-18720, p=-4q-2 gives q=-4.5 and p=16, hence p+2q=7.\n\nFor q-18027, area=22·26·sin(11°)/2≈54.57137, rounding to 54.57. For q-43339, 15=5·12·sin(A)/2 gives sin(A)=1/2; the depicted acute angle selects 30° rather than the supplementary 150°. For q-72768, area=18·8·sin(70°)≈135.31574, rounding to 135. For q-72764, subtracting the concave quadrilateral's area from triangle ABD gives 67.5·sin(52°)-34≈19.19073, rounding to 19.",
